entities.name: HDAC9 (Gallus gallus)
observations: Exact 594-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5ZKH6 (100% identity and coverage).
Acts as a transcription corepressor; described as lacking intrinsic deacetylase activity and promoting core-histone deacetylation by recruiting other HDACs.
Annotated to repress MEF2-dependent transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
Reference annotation localizes HDAC9 to the nucleus.

entities.name: Transcriptional repression
observations: HDAC9 annotation links histone deacetylase recruitment to epigenetic transcriptional repression and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

entities.name: Nucleus
observations: The exact-match reviewed Gallus gallus HDAC9 annotation reports nuclear localization.
